study: Visible facility categories in unknown multi-room active reconstruction

evaluation.primary: J = C_free * F1_scene_05cm, both factors expressed as fractions
evaluation.coverage: Final belief cells explicitly mapped free among the layout's evaluator-only start-reachable true free cells
evaluation.surface: Whole-scene F1 between the acquired-only native TSDF mesh and a fixed first-hit reachable reference surface for that layout at 0.05 m, with source geometry and reference hidden from the actor
evaluation.early_termination: Evaluate the actual stop. Returns and turns count as actions. No padding to the cap. Keep failed, nontriggered, unchanged and negative attempts with their receipts.
evaluation.independent_unit: A parent building layout. Swaps within a parent pair are controlled placements, not additional buildings. Report paired differences descriptively.

historical_E1.test: Exact recorded prefix and acquisition history, one initial forced route followed by the same frozen observed-state policy, preserving runtime protection. Compare native surface increment, measured actions before frontier resumption, terminal J and return.
historical_E1.failure_rule: Report missing or mismatched evidence if exact causal replay fails. Do not substitute a different historical state.

controlled_mechanism.design: Two different parent warehouse/gallery layouts, two opposite open-shelf and closed-cabinet placements per parent, three arms per placement with a single common online trigger and common policy outside the intervention

arms.X: Swap only the class labels used for estimating the score

per_parent_requirements: All six final observations and scored runs belong to the declared pair and share the declared acquisition and action contract. A nontrigger or unclassifiable S route fails the side-reversal criterion.

S chooses the route affording the previously occluded diagnostic facility view in both placements. The route must switch sides when furniture is swapped. Evaluation-side path labels are fixed by geometry before scores are opened.
The mean of S terminal J across both placements strictly exceeds the corresponding means for both G and X. A placement may tie if a comparator picks the same route.
S returns in any placement in which either comparator returns. Keep volumes, coverage and collision outcomes alongside the composite.
controlled_mechanism.both_supported: Release four larger independent cold-start tests with S, G, and F_strict.
controlled_mechanism.only_one_supported: Keep the large-layout confirmatory batch gated. Diagnose differences and limit any development change to one mechanism at a time on declared development layouts.
controlled_mechanism.neither_supported: Do not run confirmatory layouts. Audit availability of a usable route, ranking sensitivity to category, and realized surface and travel outcomes, then deliver the data and resulting paper judgment.

confirmatory.design: Four previously unused larger parent layouts fixed without preference to the existence of an informative junction. Evaluate continuous S category use, matched G and F_strict at common starting observation and budget.
confirmatory_metric_contrasts: S minus G: isolate category prior
S minus F_strict: compare policy systems
confirmatory.historical_boundary: B11's four smaller layouts are already examined and may be reused as descriptive context. They cannot be counted as the new held-out larger buildings. F_nearest is an implementation failure and is excluded from the effective baseline.
